correctness.rationale: If u=a1+w generates a rank-one image, proportionality of u² to u forces w=0 when a≠0 over every characteristic; otherwise the image lies in V. Cases with S=0 and mixed scalar/radical images follow by inserting general linear functionals into both defining identities. For radical/radical images, the coefficient equations in τ(x),τ(y) imply that both functionals vanish on the span of the two image lines. Counting normalized image lines and annihilating functionals gives the seven explicit category totals, and the geometric fibers over P(V) or P(V)² off diagonal have dimensions 3m−1 and 4m−4. Independently implemented all 2,500 pairs of GF(2)-linear rank≤1 maps on the three-dimensional local algebra, checking both original identities on nine ordered basis pairs each: 90 accepted in seven categories 1,16,16,12,12,27,6 as predicted. Finite test corroborates rather than proves arbitrary-field statement.
residual_risks: Irreducibility is for locally closed reduced strata only; no complete component decomposition or nonreduced multiplicity claim.
